explanation: The area purpose covers finding, reading, choosing states and raw file editing, but its capability list also holds Managing policy definitions (loading, downloading and inspecting ADMX/ADML files, products and support rules; Microsoft Download Center, msiexec). The purpose never says people load or download definition files, and Running the program separately claims loading definitions at start-up. Reword the purpose to include managing the definition files the policies come from, and keep Running the program to start-up and shutdown so the two do not overlap.
